'''Michael Crosby Non-Pilots Need Not Apply''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Michael Crosby]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)|Hoth-D-hothiceplains.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Non-Pilots Need Not Apply
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Non-Pilots Need Not Apply Crosby D.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck is very effective against most any Light Side assault. It is extermely powerful in space, strong on the ground, and generates plenty of force. Attack Runs do little damage since there are no Death Star sites (though the system is present), and the high destiny average (2.75) helps you win most of the battles. Note that half the cards are rare: if you do not have the money to obtain all the cards, feel free to substitute where you see fit.

== Strategy ==

Aim to force drain at the 3 sites that let you drain for two force (the Defensive Perimeter, the Moisture Farm and the Jundland Wastes), protecting these in space with ships at the respective systems (which drain one extra force at Tatooine and Hoth). The sabers add to the drain. If the chance allows, fight the light side, preferably with Vader and his destiny bonus cards. The Walkers are for protection from the Hoth environment (Ice Storm, etc.) and for a big power boost on the ground.
